summary: No dossier sell trigger tripped. Super Micro's CFO left immediately (Mark Long named); reason unconfirmed, integrity question open (METHOD 4). Enova ended its Grasshopper merger for $4M. Insurers beat but sit far above MOS. Chip sell-off is market-wide noise.
